4070.title: Environment loading gap at provider startup
4070.rootCauseOneLine: Provider startup forwards inherited variables and explicit overrides without resolving the directory environment; an oversized plugin resolver is discarded as a whole.
4070.proposedFix: Define an approved host-local directory-environment loading contract and explicit contribution-failure behavior, then cover the agent-to-MCP path.
4070.caveats: Two clean component runs; no real WSL2, direnv-approved directory, Claude process, or MCP authentication reproduction. No simple fix: policy and public contract decisions are required.
